title: Pulmonary Aspergillosis
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Pulmonary aspergillosis is a spectrum of lung diseases caused by Aspergillus spp., most commonly Aspergillus fumigatus. Manifestations vary depending on host immunity and underlying lung disease.
